text: Assumption: Concurrent read calls are thread-safe without synchronization — is this correct?

norm: concurrent read calls are thread safe without synchronization
assumption: Concurrent read calls are thread-safe without synchronization.
rationale: The specification text makes no statement regarding concurrency; the property is derived from const and noexcept.
